newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Oct private construction rises 22pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Greek Oct private construction rises 22pct yr/yr.

text.p: Greece's index of private construction activity, measured by construction volume based on the number of building permits issued, rose 22.8 percent year-on-year in October, the National Statistics Service (NSS) said in a statement.
"In October construction volume based on the number of building permits nationwide reached 4.939 million cubic metres against 4.022 million in October 1995, an increase of 22.8 percent," NSS said.
In the first ten months of the year, private construction activity was up 22 percent with the rise more pronounced in the Attica region where it rose 36.8 percent, the statement said.
